commands.command:
mkdir -p /usr/local/bin
cat > /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
DATA_DIR=/var/lib/inventory
while true; do
  ts=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
  printf '%s host=%s uptime=%s\n' "$ts" "$(hostname)" "$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/uptime)" >> "$DATA_DIR/inventory.log"
  sleep 10
done
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh
cat /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh

commands.command:
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory background worker
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh
User=inventory-worker
Group=inventory-worker
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2

NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory
PrivateTmp=yes
PrivateDevices=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectKernelLogs=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
ProtectClock=yes
ProtectHostname=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
RestrictRealtime=yes
RestrictNamespaces=yes
LockPersonality=yes
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=yes
RemoveIPC=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=
AmbientCapabilities=
UMask=0027

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_EOF
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now inventory-worker.service
sleep 2
systemctl is-active inventory-worker.service
systemctl status inventory-worker.service --no-pager -l | head -30
